 DAVANAGERE DISTRICT AND ETC.

1  CP No. 247 of 2021  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The present petition is filed seeking for transfer of MC No.1791/2021 pending on the file of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru to the Court of Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Channagiri,
Davanagere District.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Channagiri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties herein are referred to as per their relationship.

3. The relevant facts necessary for consideration of the present petition are that the marriage between the parties was solemnized on 14.12.2018, consequent to which they resided together in their matrimonial home.
Due to various reasons, initially the parties were residing separately in the year 2019 and that consequent to a legal notice dated 22.10.2020 the parties resided together.
However, they again started living separately after some time.
4. The wife has filed a complaint under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 r/w Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
The husband has filed MC NC: 2024:KHC:2268 No.1791/2021 under Section 13(1)(1a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for a decree of divorce.
Seeking transfer of said MC No.1791/2021, the wife has filed the present petition.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the wife is staying along with her mother at the address mentioned in the cause title.
That the wife has no independent source of income and is depending on her mother for her livelihood and the wife has also initiated proceedings claiming maintenance.
That the distance between Bengaluru and the place of residence of the wife is nearly 300 kms.
That the husband is gainfully employed and is working in a Multinational Company at Bengaluru.
Hence, he seeks for allowing of the present petition and granting of the reliefs sought for.
6. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent submits that no grounds have been made out for transfer of the case and seeks for dismissal of the petition.
7. The submissions of the learned counsel for the parties have been considered and the material on record have been perused.
The question that arises for consideration is, NC: 2024:KHC:2268 whether the relief sought for in the present petition is liable to be granted?
8. The relationship between the parties as also the fact that they are living separately and that the wife is residing along with her mother at the address mentioned in the cause title is undisputed.

9. In view of the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the wife has no independent source of income and is completely dependent on her mother for her livelihood as also Smt Ashwini N vs Sri Shivanaik on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25615600/
2

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
the fact that the distance between Bengaluru and the place of the residence of the wife is nearly 300 kms., and that there are no proper direct transport facility from the place of residence of the wife to Bengaluru, it is clear that the wife will be put to great hardship if she is required to contest the proceedings initiated by the husband at Bengaluru.
10.

Although some hardship will be caused to the husband if the proceedings initiated by him are transferred as sought by the wife, having regard to the fact that the husband is gainfully employed and having an independent source of income and in view of the settled proposition of law as held by NC: 2024:KHC:2268 the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA1 that while considering cases for transfer of matrimonial proceedings the convenience of wife will have to be given precedence to, it is just and proper that the relief sought for in the present petition be granted.

entities.text: N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the question framed for consideration is answered in the affirmative.

11. In view of the aforementioned, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.
The above petition is allowed; ii. MC.No.1791/2021 pending on the file of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru shall stand transferred to the Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Channagiri;
iii. Both the parties shall appear before the transferee Court on 19.02.2024 without the requirement of any further noticing being issued in this regard;
AIR ONLINE 2022 SC 1268 NC: 2024:KHC:2268 iv.
Consequent to transfer, the transferee Court shall conduct further proceedings in accordance with law; vi.
All contentions of the parties are left open.
